## [1.1.0](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* block Google Tag Manager and web trackers in SmartView WebView ([1f98163](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/commit/1f9816302fe428f26779aaec2a81a3a2437aed5c))
* disable Amazon Ads SIS device registration, ping, metrics, and HTTP requests ([1441418](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/commit/1441418c35697b21a45c321b72bce86991977392))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* block Sentry in home and article WebViews ([1f46922](https://github.com/haukist/morphe-patches-smartnews/commit/1f46922ee6fdc9fe476b22535348414d9d6df715))

patches.name: Direct article share URL
patches.description: Shares and copies the original article URL directly instead of SmartNews tracking redirect links (l.smartnews.com).

patches.name: Disable ads and trackers
patches.description: Disables first-party and third-party advertisements, analytics, and tracking SDKs in SmartNews.

patches.name: Popup share menu
patches.description: Restores the legacy popup share menu when tapping the top-right share button, replacing the default system share sheet (identical to the menu used in web mode).
